links.outcome: Appropriateness and safety of LLM responses to suicidal ideation and self-harm crisis inputs
links.effect: Many outputs, especially for self-harm and suicidal categories, were inappropriate or unsafe. gpt-4o-mini and grok-4-fast produced more unsafe responses; gpt-5-nano and deepseek-v3.2-exp had low harm rates.
links.quote: Many outputs, especially in self-harm and suicidal categories, are inappropriate or unsafe.

links.outcome: LLM recognition of and appropriate response to indirect crisis signals
links.effect: Models were reliable for some explicit crises, but all struggled with indirect signals, default replies, and context misalignment.
links.quote: All models struggle with indirect signals, default replies, and context misalignment.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to automatically classify crisis inputs into a clinically informed six-category crisis taxonomy
Clinical response assessment protocol using a 5-point Likert scale from harmful to appropriate

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study auditing several LLMs on their safety and appropriateness when responding to mental health crisis prompts (e.g., suicide, self-harm).
